evidence_quality.rule: DOWNLOADED_PUBLIC is transport success only. Gate review requires semantic candidate specificity or exact trusted official attachment provenance; publication notice PDFs are never promoted. Provenance proves authority, not eligibility, and mandatory-gate UNKNOWN remains UNKNOWN.
